message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar charts comparing Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B accuracy across three iterations on math and general reasoning benchmarks.","description":"Two side-by-side grouped bar charts show Accuracy across Iter1, Iter2, and Iter3. In both panels, green bars represent Qwen3-4B and light-blue bars represent Qwen3-8B, as indicated by the legends. The Math AVG panel has a vertical axis from 50 to 60; the General AVG panel runs from 30 to 40, so neither axis starts at zero. Estimated bar readings: in Math AVG, Qwen3-4B rises slightly from about 51.9 to 52.2 to 52.5, while Qwen3-8B rises from about 55.1 to 55.6 to 58.2, with a larger increase at Iter3. In General AVG, Qwen3-4B rises from about 31.5 to 31.9 to 32.6, and Qwen3-8B from about 36.0 to 36.2 to 36.7.
